g.text: Local organization during a short second-half window
Largest original size; f=0.1. Fixed display window begins at half the run; white line marks the native profile shown below.
Morphology-descriptor medoid per condition; each currently has two paths, so both tie and the smaller seed is selected. No typicality claim.
A region is a connected arc above half current contrast; counts need amplitude context. Goryachev’s high-input noisy AND mean-control profiles have low contrast.
Snapshots are fixed in advance within the displayed windows, not selected for extra peaks. Regions do not establish competition or site lineage; no duration classifier.
Native activity; no alignment/peak normalization. Saved fields: chemicals40, Spring4 native units; actual C(t) enters Spring M₀/M₁. Laws/clocks differ.
